messages:
elaine_support: Hi team — customer ACME reporting repeated 401s + intermittent latency spikes on /v1/chat. They attached a debug bundle and a request id r-0a1b2c3d. Need repro steps and a PII-safe bundle for eng triage.

mike_engineering: Can you paste the exact curl they used? Also which model and region?

elaine_support: They called our hosted API in us-west-2, model=redwood-rlhf-3b, seq len ~1024. Customer sent this sanitized curl (tokens removed):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<USER_PROMPT_REMOVED>"}],"max_tokens":128}'
```

mike_engineering: That won't fully repro — we need the original prompt shape (length/structure). Ask them to pseudonymize (UID_1 style) rather than removing content entirely.

alex_cs: I asked the customer for a pseudonym mapping CSV that replaces their opaque ids/hashes with stable tokens. They are hesitant to send original IDs.

sanjay_oncall: Oncall findings: traced the 401 burst to token refresh failures. Log snippet from their bundle: 

```
2026-03-15T20:14:03Z auth: token refresh failed: 401 invalid_grant
req_id=r-0a1b2c3d route=/v1/chat latency_ms=4235
```

sanjay_oncall: Also saw a transient backend CPU spike at the same time — recommend full scrubbed bundle for correlation.

elaine_support: Customer will share a bundle if we strip PII. Current upload contains emails and long tenant IDs. We need a precise scrub recipe.

privacy-bot: Recommended command: `scripts/scrub_debug_bundle.sh --map-csv mapping.csv --strip-emails --mask-cc` — mapping.csv should map original -> PSEUDO_ID. Do NOT include API tokens, private keys, or raw credit card numbers.

mike_engineering: If customer refuses mapping.csv, we can run a deterministic hash to map long IDs to UID_XXXX, but we must get explicit consent. Hash preserves structure/length properties for repro.

elaine_support: Customer approved deterministic hashing. They will upload a new scrubbed bundle by EOD. Also requested a minimal curl that preserves header order and body size.

alex_cs: FYI billed usage anomaly tied to this tenant (invoice INV-2041). Finance might want to join if it looks like runaway cost.

elaine_support: Proposed plan: 1) customer uploads hashed mapping + scrubbed bundle; 2) eng will attempt local repro with exact seq length/auth flow (mike); 3) privacy-bot will vet the scrub; 4) escalate to infra if CPU reproduces (sanjay).

mike_engineering: I'll run with `--kv-cache=false --batch-size=1` to mimic single-request latency and post exact commands here. If you have the original req_ids, include them so I can grep logs.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood-rlhf-3b@canary scheduled in 30m — will abort if repro surfaces. :warning:

elaine_support: Thanks — I'll add the upload link when it's available. I'll also ask customer to keep the same prompt tokenization shape (replace emails with EMAIL_1 etc). :thumbsup:

privacy-bot: Reminder: mask samples like so: `email=EMAIL_***`, `user_id=UID_XXXX`, `cc_masked=************1234`. Do not share unredacted API keys/tokens.

mike_engineering: Also please put the exact curl used into `repro/curl.txt` inside the bundle so we don't have to guess header ordering. Shortest reproducible example preferred.

elaine_support: Uploaded: /uploads/1999995432-acme-scrubbed-bundle.tar.gz — mapping.csv contains pseudonyms UID_0001..UID_0020, no raw emails or full IDs.

mike_engineering: Downloading now and will kick off repro. I'll publish the runbook commands and results in this thread.

sanjay_oncall: Logging note: enable trace level DEBUG for 10s during repro to capture the auth dance, then revert.

elaine_support: Closing loop after eng runs repro. Will ping if customer uploads anything else.
